name: zsnd_cd_on_mci_notify
description: zSndCd::OnMciNotify replays the current CD track only when the MCI notification matches loop playback state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zSndCd media-control pass.
The smoke patches zSndCd::PlayTrackWithMode so the accepted replay path and argument contract can be verified without issuing MCI commands.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4a26b0 tests the ready flag bit, last play mode 5, low 16 bits of the MCI device id against lParam, and wParam 1 before tail-calling zSndCd::PlayTrackWithMode(currentTrack, 5).
The native smoke covers the accepted loop-notify replay path and representative guard failures for wParam, lParam, play mode, and ready flag.
